decisions.reason: It is an adjacent laser-marking product within the firm's long-established competence base, and despite only modest website prominence the firm's strong in-house R&D and service capabilities make continued learning and support more likely than withdrawal.

This thermal inkjet printer is close to the core coding and marking business, remained on its own product page across both years, and fits a German machinery firm's tendency to retain technically related products it can refine through internal R&D.

The piezo inkjet printer is also closely related to existing knowledge and was still prominently marketed in 2024, so the firm is well positioned to interpret market feedback and improve it rather than discontinue it.

Industrial laser marking systems directly extend the firm's established offer and were highlighted on the home page at launch, indicating strategic importance and a high likelihood of further commercialization effort instead of exit.

The compact laser marking cabin is a new but highly related addition to the laser portfolio, and the firm's absorptive capacity from in-house development and broad installed-base knowledge argues for keeping and scaling it.

Although this lubricant printing system is more specialized, it still builds on the firm's marking expertise and its trade-fair award provides positive early validation, making continuation more likely than removal.
